items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I played with him with Nelson Riddle, and then Nat Cole and did a few recordings and with Duke Ellington

ctx.x: Here is another short called 'Caravan,' three minutes long. It was probably one of those -- yeah, made by Snyder. They made them for those visual jukeboxes, a little film that would go on when you put your money in, and apparently, they did 'Caravan.' It says 'Duke Ellington and his orchestra played the title number with solo by Juan Tizol, trombone, and featuring Jimmy Hamilton, Willie Smith, Russell Procope, Paul Gonzalves, Harry Carney, Ray Nance, Willie Cook, Cat Anderson, Britt Woodman, Quentin Jackson, and…
